statement: The pinned SDL Triton consumer declares TRITON_SENSOR_UPDATE_INTERVAL_US=4032 microseconds and uses 1000000/4032 (about 248.016 Hz) as the advertised sensor update rate when opening the joystick. Its separate source comment says that the USB descriptor reports 1 kHz but actual sensing is about four milliseconds; this is SDL commentary, NOT a captured descriptor, verified sampling rate or hardware validation. SDL driver lines 40-41,570-582. Measured direct-wired sensor cadence and USB descriptor evidence: No evidence.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3-rc1 or SDL Triton 6defbc0 host-source pin; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Direct wired USB 28de:1302 source-derived consumer expectation only. All timings are host scheduling assumptions or source comments; physical measurement: No evidence.
